She swings a golf club with a wide arc but misses the small white golf ball entirely. (2) The woman stands still, holding the club vertically while looking slightly off-camera. Behind her, the driving range is expansive with green ground and high netting supported by tall metal towers under a soft, overcast sunset sky. (3) A man dressed in a black hoodie, black joggers, and a camouflage baseball cap enters the frame from the right. He crouches down to place a massive, oversized white sphere onto the mat, replacing the tiny ball. (4) The woman reacts with a smile and wide-eyed surprise, gesturing with her hands towards the giant ball before repositioning her feet and gripping her golf club to prepare for a second attempt.
